## The operational problem

During seasonal work as a Sales and Records Assistant at **ALFA STORE (2021–2026)**, I maintained records covering beverage sales, customer collections, returned goods, quantities, and costs. These records supported daily reconciliation.

Manual sales calculations created repetitive work. I identified the inefficiency and developed a digital costing and reconciliation tool to support the workflow.

## Reported outcome

My CV records an **approximately 80% reduction in sales calculation time**. This is a reported workplace achievement; timing measurements and a public demonstration are not included here.

## My contribution

- Maintained transaction and inventory records.
- Supported cost calculations and daily reconciliation.
- Identified a repetitive manual process and developed a digital tool to improve it.

## What this demonstrates

Practical problem framing, record accuracy, process improvement, and connecting a technical solution to everyday business work.
